messages.content: 在撲克牌中獲得一副葫蘆的機率是多少？

function.name: poker_probability_full_house
function.description: Calculate the probability of getting a full house in a poker game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

deck_size.description: The size of the deck. Default is 52.

hand_size.description: The size of the hand. Default is 5.

message.content:
在標準 52 張牌、抽 5 張牌的情況下，得到「葫蘆」（三張同點 + 一對）的機率為  

\[
P(\text{full house})=\frac{13 \binom{4}{3}\; \times\; 12 \binom{4}{2}}{\binom{52}{5}}
   =\frac{3744}{2\,598\,960}
   \approx 0.001440576 \;\text{(約 0.144%)} .
\]

也就是說，在所有可能的 5 張手牌中，大約有 0.144% 的機會是葫蘆。

The user asks: "在撲克牌中獲得一副葫蘆的機率是多少？" which means "What is the probability of getting a full house in a poker hand?" They want the probability. We can compute using combinatorics: For standard 52-card deck, 5-card hand. Number of ways to get a full house: choose rank for triple (13 choices), choose 3 cards from 4 suits of that rank: C(4,3). Choose rank for pair from remaining 12 ranks: C(12,1). Choose 2 cards from 4 suits of that rank: C(4,2). So total favorable hands: 13 * C(4,3) * 12 * C(4,2) = 13*4 * 12*6 = 13*4=52; 12*6=72; product 52*72 = 3744. Total possible 5-card hands: C(52,5)=2,598,960. Probability = 3744 / 2598960 ≈ 0.001440576... ~ 0.144%. So answer: about 0.00144 or 0.144%. Provide explanation.
